name: BV-CHP (Brentuximab vedotin + Cyclophosphamide + DOXOrubicin + Prednisone)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.ALK: ALK-positive or ALK-negative systemic ALCL (prognostic; not a dosing gate)
biomarkers.note: Brentuximab vedotin is a CD30-directed antibody-drug conjugate; CD30 positivity is the biomarker gate for BV-CHP (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), T-cell Lymphomas v2.2026, lines 803 and 807: CHP + Brentuximab vedotin for CD30+ histologies). Systemic ALCL is uniformly CD30-positive. ALK status is prognostic and does not change dosing.

treatmentSetting: primary therapy for previously untreated CD30-positive systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma (and other CD30-positive PTCL)
histology: systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALK-positive or ALK-negative), and other CD30-positive peripheral T-cell lymphomas

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: anthracycline-containing regimen; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

supportiveCare: G-CSF: consider primary prophylaxis per febrile-neutropenia risk of the CHP backbone.
Brentuximab vedotin: monitor for peripheral neuropathy; hold/reduce for grade 2 or higher. Vincristine is intentionally omitted (CHP, not CHOP) to avoid overlapping neurotoxicity with brentuximab.
Tumor lysis syndrome prophylaxis for high tumor burden.
monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle
peripheral neuropathy assessment each visit (brentuximab vedotin)
cumulative anthracycline dose tracking (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2)

doseModificationRules.text: Reduce or hold brentuximab vedotin for grade 2 or higher peripheral neuropathy per labeling; clinical review.

drugs.name: Brentuximab vedotin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 10.1, lines 20811 to 20812: brentuximab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks (day 1 of a 21-day cycle), with body-weight dosing capped at 100 kg. Table 10.1 lists this dose/schedule for refractory systemic ALCL; frontline BV-CHP (ECHELON-2) uses the identical 1.8 mg/kg every-3-week dose, and the frontline setting is grounded to the NCCN CHP + brentuximab entry. CD30-directed ADC (MMAE); monitor for peripheral neuropathy. Requires CD30 positivity.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Table 10.1 (antineoplastic drug reference), Brentuximab vedotin entry, lines 20811 to 20812: 1.8 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks, maximum dose per 100 kg, for (refractory) Hodgkin lymphoma and systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV on day 1. The CHP backbone is grounded to the StewardMD R1-approved R-CHOP (kb/protocols/rchop.json), which encodes the canonical CHOP cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 bsa on day 1.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Grounded to the StewardMD R1-approved R-CHOP backbone (kb/protocols/rchop.json): canonical CHOP cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 bsa IV on day 1.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: DOXOrubicin 50 mg/m2 IV on day 1. The CHP backbone is grounded to the StewardMD R1-approved R-CHOP (kb/protocols/rchop.json), which encodes the canonical CHOP doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 bsa on day 1. Anthracycline: track cumulative lifetime dose (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2). ISMP tall-man DOXOrubicin.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Grounded to the StewardMD R1-approved R-CHOP backbone (kb/protocols/rchop.json): canonical CHOP doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 bsa IV on day 1, with anthracycline cumulative cap warn 450 / hard 550 mg/m2.

drugs.name: Prednisone
drugs.notes: Prednisone 100 mg PO flat on days 1 to 5. The CHP backbone is grounded to the StewardMD R1-approved R-CHOP (kb/protocols/rchop.json); rchop names the steroid Prednisolone while this file uses Prednisone (same 100 mg flat days 1 to 5, interchangeable CHOP steroid).
